thesis: Buying a high-beta, richly valued small cap in a 0.9-confidence risk-off tape on a thin half-day session is poor timing. The price sits 6.5% below a 50.06 high set on an unexplained gap, and the first resistance at 50.06 gives only about 1.3 R/R. The 2.7 R/R depends on a 54.4 target that needs a clean break of that high while QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages. Forward P/E 52.6 and EV/EBITDA 46.9 leave no valuation cushion, and GAAP profit is only just positive. The gaps on Oct 2 and Nov 11 have no known cause and have reversed before (Oct 2 to Oct 7, Nov 11 to Nov 12), so the base may not hold. Short interest of 19.6% and ATR of 6.2% make a stop-out likely if the market sells off again.
